Who you are

We're looking for an experienced Retail Interior Design and Visual merchandising Specialist, who can inspire and surprise our customers by presenting and communicating the IKEA home furnishing offer through inspirational, functional, and aesthetic range presentations and can share our home furnishing knowledge by contributing and participating in events and activities, workshops, Instagram, Live shopping etc.

• You have a high passion for creating inspiring store solutions for an easy and convenient shopping experience and increasing vitality by translating deep knowledge about consumer buying behavior, store layout, range presentation, and local market knowledge.

• You are innovative, dare to challenge yourself and always want to improve and learn.

• You are easy to adapt to changes and able to act quickly to exploit commercial opportunities.

• You have a high visual competence with a keen eye for aesthetics, ability to draw, visualize and present an idea.

• Computer proficient with knowledge and experience of using relevant software e.g. Revit

To succeed in this assignment, you will contribute to togetherness; build strong relationships, collaborate, and co-create with your many colleagues with your creative mindset. You can make things happen with flexibility, speed, and simplicity.

Your responsibilities

• Work hands-on on the shop floor and use your retail design & visual merchandising competence to strengthen the uniqueness of the IKEA identity in range presentation solutions by working with the store layout, range presentation, and vitality.

• Secure high quality, simplicity, efficiency, and cost consciousness in planning and implementing all range presentations by applying national and global tools and best practices.

• Secure vitality and seasonality in the store by contributing and implementing the commercial calender.

Our team within IKEA

You will become part of a strong team in our Home Furnishing & Retail Design function, consisting of graphic designers, interior designers, visual merchandisers, and leaders. While others see furniture, we see smart home furnishing solutions that can create a better everyday life for many people. With passion and imagination, we transform colors, textiles, and furniture into inspiring environments that surprise and convince our customers. We work closely with other departments every day, giving you experience in collaborating with many different people. We are an international team with a strong sense of unity, where we support each other and work together. There is therefore room to be exactly who you are. We provide the right training so you can feel confident and competent in the job. At IKEA, you have endless opportunities for development.

Apply now!

Please notice that we do not receive applications via e-mail but only through our recruitment portal.

Further information

• The position is 37 hours per week on average

• We offer various employee benefits, including a pension plan, health insurance, massage program, canteen, employee discount, discount agreements with partners, annual gift etc.

PhD in Physical AI for Adaptive Robot Manipulation
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Electrical and Computer Engineering programme. The position is available from 01 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
PhD in Physical AI for Adaptive Robot Manipulation

Research area and project description
Applications are invited for a fully funded three-year PhD position at the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aarhus University. The position is part of STORM (Soft Tactile Memory for Safe Physical-AI Correction of Robotic Foundation Models), a new project funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark (DFF). The candidate will join the Adaptive & Agentic AI (A3) Lab, headed by Dr. Behzad Bozorgtabar (main supervisor), and will work closely with Professor Ahmad Rafsanjani and the SDU Soft Robotics group, who are developing the soft tactile skin.

Research vision
How can a robot foundation model use physical feedback to correct an action during execution? Models such as vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models let robots follow natural-language instructions, but they act on what they see rather than on what they feel. When a grasp begins to slip or a fragile object deforms, the camera view often looks fine until the damage is done. STORM gives robotic foundation models a sense of touch, so that a robot can notice when a manipulation is going wrong and correct itself safely while it acts.

PhD project
The candidate will develop the machine-learning core of STORM. The work spans three connected scientific questions, leaving room for the candidate to shape the specific algorithmic directions: (1) How can contact representations be learned from advanced tactile interfaces, including a soft-fluidic tactile skin developed at SDU? (2) How can predictive models forecast how contact states should evolve over short horizons under a policy's intended actions? (3) How can the mismatch between expected and felt contact drive parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained foundation policies while guaranteeing safety? Methods will be evaluated on public benchmark and real-world robotic setup, focusing on dexterous manipulation of fragile and unseen objects as well as safe human-robot interaction.

Environment
The project sits at the intersection of machine learning, Physical AI, robot foundation models (e.g., VLA and World-Action models), world models, tactile sensing, and adaptation algorithms—areas in which the A3 Lab publishes regularly at top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, and CoRL. The PhD includes a possible planned research stay at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, and close collaboration with the SDU team.

Qualifications and specific competences
This is a highly selective position; applicants are expected to meet the requirements below.

Education: A master’s degree (120 ECTS or equivalent) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field, completed or nearing completion before the start date.

Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or adapting modern deep architecture such as Transformers, state-space/sequence models, and diffusion or flow-matching models.

Core Knowledge: A strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, or computer vision, combined with a strong motivation to work on Physical AI, multimodal tactile sensing, world models, and online adaptation, etc.

Relevant Research Experience (one or more of the following is highly advantageous):
 
• Robot & Policy Learning: Imitation learning, behavior cloning, offline/model-based RL, or policy learning for manipulation (e.g., diffusion policies, Vision-Language-Action models, or World-Action models), as well as familiarity with manipulation benchmarks (e.g., LIBERO, CALVIN, or ManiSkill).
• World Models & Sequential Representation Learning: Self-supervised learning on temporal or multimodal sensor streams, action-conditioned video/dynamics prediction, latent world models, or uncertainty estimation.
• Model Adaptation & Post-Training: Test-time adaptation (TTA), continual/online learning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), or safe/constrained policy updates.
Hands-on Robotics: Prior experience with physical robot platforms, grippers, tactile/force sensors, and ROS 2 is an advantage, but not strictly required for candidates with an exceptional machine learning background. However, a strong willingness to work with physical hardware and run real-robot experiments is required.

Track Record: Evidence of strong research potential—such as a strong master’s thesis, open-source research code, or publications/submissions at leading ML, vision, or robotics venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, CoRL, RSS, ICRA)—is a strong advantage.

Attributes: A mindset for scientific rigor, reproducibility, and open-source contribution, the ability to collaborate across algorithmic AI and physical hardware teams, and excellent written and spoken English.

Application Requirements (How to Apply)
Please ensure your application includes the following documents:
• Statement of Interest (1 page): Detailing your background in machine learning, computer vision or robotics, any work experience relevant to the position, and your motivation for joining the A3 Lab and the project.
• Curriculum Vitae: Including a publication list (if applicable) and a technical project page, with links to code repositories or videos of experiments where available.
• Academic Records: Transcripts and diplomas (Bachelor’s and Master’s).Project Description Requirement: The candidate is required to use the project description from the PhD announcement.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Adaptive & Agentic AI (A3) Lab, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE), Faculty of Technical

Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Agroecology programme. The position is available from 15 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
New paradigm to disentangle hydrothermal stresses and assess regional agricultural vulnerability to drought-heatwave events

Research area and project description
The Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in remote sensing and knowledge-guided machine learning to assess agricultural vulnerability to drought and heatwaves. The expected starting date is 15 March 2027. The position is supported by the Sino-Danish Center for Education and Research (SDC) and involves collaboration with Chinese Academy of Sciences, including a research stay of 12 months.

Food security, climate change and biodiversity loss represent three major environmental sustainability challenges. The Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Futures (Land-CRAFT), established in June 2022, with expertise in biogeochemistry, agronomy and climate-impact research. This PhD project aims to develop a knowledge-guided machine-learning framework that combines remote sensing, field observations and process-based models to disentangle interacting stresses and assess agricultural vulnerability at regional scales. The research will distinguish the effects of soil water limitation, vapour pressure deficit, and temperature on crop productivity. The resulting knowledge and methods will support early warning, precision irrigation and agricultural climate-risk assessment.

The PhD student will work on three interconnected research tasks:
1. Develop an integrated observation framework for crop drought and heat responses. Combine thermal infrared, multispectral and hyperspectral remote sensing with soil moisture measurements, meteorological observations and field data to characterise crop responses across contrasting environmental conditions.
2. Disentangle the individual and interacting effects of water and heat stress. Quantify how soil-water availability, atmospheric demand and temperature influence crop functioning and productivity, and identify the conditions under which their interactions intensify crop stress.
3. Assess regional agricultural vulnerability to compound drought–heatwave events.
Scale the identified stress-response relationships from field observations to regional assessments, identifying vulnerability patterns, critical thresholds and hotspots.

SDC is a partnership between all eight Danish universities and the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS). It brings together Danish and Chinese research and education environments through collaborative research, joint supervision and international mobility. Participation offers the PhD student opportunities to gain research experience in both countries and build an international scientific network.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**This role provides medical oversight of product safety, including adverse event review, ongoing safety surveillance, and management of emerging safety issues. Responsibilities include safety input to clinical and regulatory deliverables, aggregate reporting, safety committee oversight, cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring regulatory compliance and inspection readiness.

**Responsibilities

**

• Perform medical review of Adverse Events reports for Genmab products.

• Perform ongoing surveillance of safety data from Genmab clinical trials.

• Ensure handling of safety issues.

• Perform medical review and provide input to e.g., Trial Protocols and amendments, Trial Reports, Trial plans, eCRFs/CRFs, TMFs, Investigator’s Brochures, Subject Informed Consent, Development Safety Update Reports, Integrated Safety Summaries, scientific articles, and medical reviews.

• Prepare aggregated reports and safety summaries in accordance with regulatory requirements.

• Responsible for the establishment and management of external Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs)

• Chair and manage Genmab Safety Committees

• Conduct training of Genmab employees, CROs and Investigators

• Member of Clinical Management Teams (CMTs), Compound Development Teams (CDT) and Compound Strategy Teams (CST) and contribute to multidisciplinary project groups and provide input to clinical development programs.

• Interact with safety and clinical CROs and perform sponsor oversight activities.

• Collaborate with external experts and partners.

• Contribute to multidisciplinary project groups.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal procedures in order to be prepared for audits and inspections.

• Participate in audit and inspection activities as relevant

**Requirements

**

• Medical degree (MD or equivalent) with relevant clinical experience; oncology or hematology experience preferred.

• 8+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, or clinical development within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry.

• Demonstrated experience in adverse event medical review, safety surveillance, signal evaluation, benefit–risk assessment, and aggregate safety reporting.

• Experience providing medical safety input to clinical trials and regulatory deliverables, including protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, informed consent documents, DSURs, clinical study reports, and integrated safety summaries.

• Strong knowledge of global pharmacovigilance and clinical development requirements, with experience supporting Safety Committees/DMCs, regulatory submissions, audits, and inspections.

• Strong medical judgment, leadership, and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, CROs, external partners, and regulatory stakeholders.

• Experience executing processes/projects in own area (e.g. guidance documents as per intl. regulations & reporting requirements; preparation of post-marketing spontaneous and clinical trial safety assessments; regulatory submissions; safety case processing; PV data systems; safety data base systems and the report generation)

• Experience working with FDA/EMA/PMDA/ICH requirements, good clinical practices, and pharmaceutical clinical development

• Experience guiding team members around complex issues

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$200,000.00---$300,000.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

HARMAN Professional develops automated lighting fixtures under the Martin brand. Martin by HARMAN is one of the world leaders in R&D and manufacturing automated, intelligent entertainment and architectural lighting.

This role is focused on the long term, building the Martin Professional Lighting brand across markets and territories across the world, and contributes to the success of the Harman Professional Solutions global business.

But that's not all - at HARMAN, you'll have the opportunity to be heard and respected, to rapidly develop your skills and cultivate new ideas in our agile and supportive culture.

You will be part of our Product Management team, based in Aarhus, Denmark in the position of:

Product Manager, Theatre & Broadcast Lighting

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.,

• Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Harman Kardon, Mark Levinson and Revel.

• Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development.

The Product Manager, Theatre & Broadcast Lighting, is an expert that manages all aspects of the product life cycle process for the full portfolio this position owns. This role will be expected to conduct market research, generate product specifications and pricing, create business plans and support strategy development for this product portfolio. The role will need to be able lead and liaise with other internal teams including R&D, regional sales, global marketing and operations teams.

How You’ll Make An Impact:

The Product Manager will work with his superior to develop portfolio strategies in line with the long-term strategic vision for this segment. The Product Manager will have an in-depth working knowledge of these products and their application. Essential responsibilities will include:

• 
Via broad cross-functional collaboration, lead products through the full lifecycle - from concept, development and launch, through sustaining lifetime initiatives until final discontinuation or replacement.

• 
Analyse markets and competitors, then translate insights into clear value propositions and customer requirements found on a deep understanding of application needs.

• 
Develop and maintain the product roadmap in line with strategy, market demands, and future opportunities.

• 
Prepare new product proposals, business cases, and concept documents for new products.

• 
Apply strong product and market knowledge to educate and collaborate with Sales, helping grow product market share.

• 
Partner with Marketing and Sales to plan and execute product launches and go-to-market activities that ensure strong positioning and successful market introductions.

• 
Support development of marketing assets for launch and sustaining needs.

• 
Educate Sales Directors and their teams with clear product messaging and support with ad-hoc promotional initiatives, trade shows, sales events etc.

• 
Produce and support development of sales enablement assets and tools.

• 
Train and support Product and Application Specialists.

• 
Contribute to team goals by collaborating and delivering related tasks as needed.

• 
Set product pricing using market research and business intelligence, while considering production and sales costs and volume forecasts from regional sales teams.

• 
Track sales performance of portfolio and identify needs for promotions, sales tools, or other activities needed to address underperforming products or regions.

• 
Maintain solid market, technical, and commercial expertise through direct hands-on engagement with customers, end users, and lighting designers, supplemented by industry media, professional networks, and events.

What Makes You A Strong Fit:

• Extensive experience in the professional live event and stage lighting industry, especially around theatre and broadcast lighting.

• Expert level of lighting products for this segment.

• In depth knowledge of the performance lighting market with thorough understanding of needs and workflows for customers, lighting designers and other industry professionals.

• Thorough understanding of sub-verticals, applications and use cases.

• Ability to configure, program and operate lighting console for product demos and reviews.

• Must be fluent in English in all areas: reading, writing and speaking.

• To complete the demands of the role this person must:

o   Have experience writing detailed and sound business plans

and product specifications.

o   Strong interpersonal skills and ability to vary personal style to

different audiences, including sales and marketing team

members and R&D project teams.

o   Excellent presentation and communication skills for internal

and external events.

o   Proven negotiating and motivational skills involved in

resourcing projects for new products.

Things To Know:

• Willingness to work at Harman Professional Denmark office in Aarhus.

• Willingness to travel globally a minimum of 50 days per year.

What You Can Expect:

• 
A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.

• 
Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others).

• 
Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs.

• 
Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.

• 
Tuition reimbursement support.

• 
Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available.

• 
An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development.
